items.name: Revenue backlog (remaining performance obligations) as of June 30, 2026
items.claim: As of June 30, 2026, Alphabet had $519.5 billion of remaining performance obligations ('revenue backlog'), of which $513.9 billion related to Google Cloud.
items.source_excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, we had $ 519.5 billion of remaining performance obligations (“revenue backlog”), of which $ 513.9 billion related to Google Cloud.

notes: Alphabet's Q2 2026 10-Q (fetched as web_doc per REQ-20260914-782, pull-data skill) discloses total revenue backlog and the Google Cloud portion.
